title: How Camila Mendes Became a Real-Life Warrior for 'Masters of the Universe'
summary: Imagine holding a real sword that's almost as tall as you! That's what Camila Mendes did to play Teela in the new 'Masters of the Universe' movie. Teela is the captain of the Royal Guard on a faraway planet called Eternia. She's a super-strong warrior who protects the kingdom alongside He-Man. But Camila didn't just pretend to be tough—she actually became tough. 'I had a lot of sword training,' she said. She also practiced with a rifle staff, which is like a long stick that shoots. 'When I finally got those props, that's when it really started to come together,' she said. The weapons felt like a part of her. Camila also lifted weights to build muscle, just like Teela would have done as a young girl. 'Through all the weight training and stunt training, I felt like I was literally becoming Teela,' she said. But Teela isn't just about fighting. Inside, she's sensitive and caring. Camila says Teela had to grow up fast and take on big responsibilities, which many kids today can understand. In the movie, you see her soft side when she's with her dad, Duncan (played by Idris Elba), or her childhood friend Adam, who is also He-Man. The movie is full of sci-fi, fantasy, and 80's fun. It hits theaters June 5. So, are you ready to see a warrior with a heart?
why_it_matters: You might see that being tough doesn't mean hiding your feelings, and working hard at something—like a sport or a school play—can make you feel like a real hero.

background_read: Masters of the Universe started as a popular toy line and cartoon in the 1980s; He-Man, the main hero, became famous for his catchphrase 'By the power of Grayskull!'
Camila Mendes (known for playing Veronica on the TV show Riverdale) took on this action role to show a new side of her acting.
Idris Elba, who plays Teela's father Duncan, is a well-known British actor who has also been in big superhero and sci-fi movies.
Article_Structure: WHO: Actress Camila Mendes, who plays Teela in the new Masters of the Universe movie.
WHAT: She trained with swords and a rifle staff, lifted weights, and did stunt training to become the warrior Teela.
WHERE: The story is set on the fictional planet Eternia, and the movie will be in theaters on June 5.
WHY: To bring the 1980s fantasy world to life and show that a warrior can be both strong and emotionally caring.
